prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Survival Arena field-selection thumbnail. Primary request: a vast royal knight campaign encampment on trampled earth. Scene/backdrop: rows of sturdy canvas tents, several contained campfires, disciplined blue-and-gold banners without readable symbols, weapon racks and training yards; a distant command pavilion as landmark. Subject: an open central training ground crossed by a few long sparse barricades and timber dividers that split crowds while leaving multiple escape routes. Style/medium: polished hand-drawn stylized storybook cutout environment illustration; flat 2D shapes, thick slightly irregular ink outlines, matte colors, simple cel shading, subtle paper texture; warm ironic fairy-tale danger; not pixel art, not photorealistic, not 3D. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, readable 3/4 top-down overview, clear traversable routes and obstacle rhythm, one strong environmental focal landmark, foreground framing kept subtle, works when center-cropped and downscaled to a 170-pixel-high UI card. Lighting/mood: clear readable daylight, controlled contrast. Color palette: dusty ochre ground, muted canvas, deep royal blue accents, warm ember orange. Constraints: environment only; no characters, enemies, creatures, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark; no close-up object; no map labels; preserve broad open gameplay space. Avoid: dense maze, modern military objects, active battle, crowded clutter.
